items.title: The Costs of AI Acceleration
items.summary: My recent posts about AI have been optimistic. I still mean them. After spending the past couple of months rebuilding my workflow around agents, I hardly interact with the colleagues I used to study with, and working has become so rewarding that I find it hard to stop. Neither has made me want my old workflow back.
